blocks.text: Dewbell keeps the shape of gathering and releasing a small stored portion. Its pull ring makes use an ordinary physical act, even after the language around the earlier practice has become compressed.
A ribbed bell with a pull ring. Lift the ring to release its contents.
One-shot use: The shell parts and pours a broad pearly stream, then closes after emptying. The game performs the final fade.
30 silver. Infection / Parasites severity −2; reaching zero clears the treated condition. Health +10; Energy +4. No recovery-timer change or Potion Boost.
